Reconstructed images are very close to ideally low-pass filtered versions of the original image, almost without aliasing. We use the same test images which were used by Bruckstein et al. in [1], and show empirically that our method has smaller reconstruction errors, on all of them, than the errors produced by subsampling and Fourier transform methods presented in [1].</AbstractText></Abstract><AuthorList CompleteYN="Y"><Author
